unit.why: This is a footnote (הג"ה) to the author's preface. It records a single witty, self-deprecating remark by the Rozdol rebbe comparing his father R. Moshe of Sambor and R. Shimon of Jaroslaw. No events are narrated, so it is a saying, not a story.
unit.boundary_note: footnote inserted inside the author's preface; the preface text continues in the next division
